cues.en: Hello my friends and welcome to this your hands-on tutorial on CodePipeline and also a big welcome to this new section on machine learning workflow automation.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到 CodePipeline 實作，也歡迎進入機器學習工作流程自動化章節。

cues.en: Alright, so here we go, let's go to the search bar and let's enter CodePipeline.
cues.zh: 搜尋 CodePipeline。

cues.en: And here it is.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: That's an AWS service for machine learning pipelines and automation indeed release software using continuous delivery because of course we'll cover CICD and that's the CD part of the CICD pipeline.
cues.zh: 它是管線自動化服務，用持續交付發布軟體，會介紹 CI/CD，這是其中 CD。

cues.en: So here we go, CodePipeline, it takes you directly to the pipelines that you can create.
cues.zh: 進入 CodePipeline，直接到可建立的管線。

cues.en: And that's what I'm gonna show you.
cues.zh: 現在展示。

cues.en: I'm gonna show you how to create a pipeline.
cues.zh: 展示怎麼建立管線。

cues.en: You're gonna see it's super user friendly.
cues.zh: 非常容易使用。

cues.en: First you choose a category between deployment, continuous integration, the CI part of the CICD pipeline, automation,
cues.zh: 先選類別，Deployment、Continuous integration，也就是 CI、Automation，

cues.en: or you can even build your own custom pipeline, okay?
cues.zh: 或自己建立 Custom pipeline。

cues.en: So we're gonna do a couple of small round trips.
cues.zh: 會簡短看幾種。

cues.en: We won't create anything specifically, but I'm just gonna show you what you get according to the different options.
cues.zh: 不真正建立，只展示不同選項有什麼。

cues.en: So with deployment, well you can directly choose a template, which you will then configure in step three.
cues.zh: Deployment 可直接選範本，第三步設定。

cues.en: Okay, so what are the templates?
cues.zh: 有哪些範本？

cues.en: Well, first you can push to ECR as what we studied in the previous section.
cues.zh: Push to ECR，上一節學過。

cues.en: You can also deploy to ECS Fargate.
cues.zh: 也可 Deploy to ECS Fargate。

cues.en: You can deploy to cloud formation, which we also covered.
cues.zh: Deploy to CloudFormation，也介紹過。

cues.en: And you can Terraform deploy to AWS.
cues.zh: 也有 Terraform deploy to AWS。

cues.en: Alright, so let's choose one we're familiar with, like ECR, push to ECR, build and push a new container image as we studied before to Amazon ECR.
cues.zh: 選熟悉的 Push to ECR，建立、推送新容器映像到 ECR。

cues.en: And if you click next, you will be able to select the source provider.
cues.zh: 按 Next，可選來源提供者。

cues.en: This is where you store your input artifacts for your pipeline and you can choose the provider and then provide the connection details and that's exactly what will happen here.
cues.zh: 管線輸入產物存放處，選提供者，再填連線細節。

cues.en: Here are the different source providers that you can choose between Azure DevOps, Bitbucket, GitHub, if you had a GitHub app, GitHub Enterprise Server, GitLab, GitLab Self-Managed.
cues.zh: 可選 Azure DevOps、Bitbucket、GitHub App、GitHub Enterprise Server、GitLab、GitLab Self-managed。

cues.en: Okay, so once again, let's choose something we're familiar with like GitHub, okay?
cues.zh: 選熟悉的 GitHub。

cues.en: And then as you can see, you can choose an existing connection by connecting to GitHub because of course here we'll have nothing.
cues.zh: 先連 GitHub，再選現有連線，目前這裡沒有。

cues.en: So you can connect to your GitHub and then connect it here, okay?
cues.zh: 連到自己的 GitHub，再在這裡選。

cues.en: And then you choose the repository.
cues.zh: 接著選儲存庫。

cues.en: So one of your repos in your GitHub account, the default branch and the output artifact format between either CodePipeline default or full clone,
cues.zh: GitHub 某個 repo、預設分支，以及輸出產物格式，CodePipeline default 或 Full clone。

cues.en: okay, where AWS CodePipeline will pass them into data about the repository that allows subsequent actions to do a full GIT clone.
cues.zh: Full clone 會傳遞儲存庫中繼資料，讓後續動作能做完整 Git clone。

cues.en: While here, it'll use the default zip format for the artifacts in the pipeline.
cues.zh: 預設則使用 ZIP 產物格式。

cues.en: Okay, so that's how you would configure your source as GitHub.
cues.zh: 這就是 GitHub 來源設定。

cues.en: But then it's exactly the same for the other sources, you know, for the other source providers for example if you choose GitLab, well same, you have to first choose an existing connection
cues.zh: 其他來源一樣，例如 GitLab，先連線，

cues.en: by connecting to GitLab, then the repository, then the default branch, and the same output artifact format.
cues.zh: 再儲存庫、預設分支、相同輸出格式。

cues.en: Okay, and same if you choose, for example, Azure DevOps, well, same, you choose a connection owner, repository name, default branch, output artifact format.
cues.zh: Azure DevOps 也一樣，選連線、擁有者、庫名、分支、格式。

cues.en: Okay, what else can I show you?
cues.zh: 還能展示什麼？

cues.en: Bitbucket, if you wanna see, but same, it's the same configuration the connection repository, it works the same way as you can see.
cues.zh: Bitbucket 也是相同設定，連線、儲存庫，運作一樣。

cues.en: But now what I also wanted to show you is the different categories like for example continuous integration if you choose this, here once again you have the choice between several templates, CI Build Gradle,
cues.zh: 還想展示不同類別，例如 Continuous integration，同樣有多個範本，CI Build Gradle，

cues.en: or for example CI Build Python.
cues.zh: 或 CI Build Python。

cues.en: So let's choose this one where you build a Python project and if you click next you will see it's exactly the same.
cues.zh: 選 Python 專案，再 Next，完全一樣。

cues.en: You choose a source provider among the same ones we saw before.
cues.zh: 同樣選來源提供者。

cues.en: So let's choose for example, GitHub.
cues.zh: 例如 GitHub。

cues.en: And same, you choose first a connection, a repository, default branch, and the same output artifact format.
cues.zh: 再選連線、庫、分支、輸出格式。

cues.en: Okay, so it's very easy.
cues.zh: 很簡單。

cues.en: And then you configure your template that you chose in the previous step, this one, alright?
cues.zh: 接著設定上一個步驟選的範本，就是這個。

cues.en: And now if we choose for example automation, well same, then you choose a template, you can schedule a Python Build pipeline or a Gradle Build pipeline.
cues.zh: Automation 也一樣，選範本，可排程 Python Build 或 Gradle Build 管線。

cues.en: And then same, next, you choose your source provider among the same ones.
cues.zh: Next，同樣選來源。

cues.en: And then you configure the connection, the repository, default branch, output artifact format, alright?
cues.zh: 設定連線、庫、分支、格式。

cues.en: And of course if you choose to build your custom pipeline, you're gonna have much more configuration.
cues.zh: 若選自訂管線，設定更多。

cues.en: Here you see step two, you choose your pipeline settings.
cues.zh: 第二步管線設定。

cues.en: Step three, you add your source stage, step four, build stage, step five, test stage, and step six, deploy stage.
cues.zh: 第三步來源、第四建置、第五測試、第六部署。

cues.en: That's the whole pipeline that's actually a good way of seeing how the whole pipeline will look like but there you go, you also have the flexibility to customize fully your machine learning pipeline.
cues.zh: 這是完整管線，也很直觀，能完全自訂機器學習工作流程。

cues.en: Alright, so let's cancel this.
cues.zh: 取消。

cues.en: Let's cancel indeed the pipeline wizard. And there you go.
cues.zh: 取消精靈。

cues.en: That's how CodePipeline works.
cues.zh: 這就是 CodePipeline。

cues.en: And now I look forward to seeing you in the next hands-on tutorial, which will probably be on CodeBuild.
cues.zh: 期待下一堂，可能是 CodeBuild。

cues.en: So I'll see you there, and until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 到時見，在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
